title: Decoy CLI error object (version 1)
description: The one object a command writes to stdout under --json when it fails. The five named members are fixed. Any other member is per-command context (for example config, source, output, mode, or run's error_kind) and must hold JSON values only. No member carries data values.

command.description: The command the user typed, such as `fit` or `report verify`.

error.description: The plain message. A reason code is never folded into it.

code.description: The engine reason code or CLI warning code, when the failure has one.
